candidates.description: Requester ID not listed in customers and no match
candidates.why_not_covered: Existing scenarios have requester_id matching one of the customers or invalid customers; no scenario with unknown requester_id outside customers list
candidates.trigger_condition: Verify customer call with requester_id not in customers list
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might refund or behave incorrectly when requester is not a known customer
candidates.scenario_template: Request refund with requester_id not matching any customer
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario shows a requester_id outside customers array

candidates.description: Multiple customers where some are valid and some invalid
candidates.why_not_covered: Existing multi-customer scenarios either have all valid customers or one invalid but not mix of both
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must choose correct verification when multiple customers have mixed validity
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might misidentify validity and refund incorrectly
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request with multiple customers; some valid, some invalid
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing multi-customer tests have only all valid or one invalid, no mix combination

candidates.description: Payments in currency other than INR or USD
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage only shows INR and USD payments, no other currencies
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund payment in an unsupported or uncommon currency
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle currency in refund rules or approval
candidates.scenario_template: Refund payment in uncommon currency EUR
candidates.novelty_claim: No currency other than INR, USD tested

candidates.description: Fault occurs after request_approval call (response lost but approval requested)
candidates.why_not_covered: Tool faults cover get_payment and issue_refund faults, no indication of request_approval faults tested
candidates.trigger_condition: High-value refund triggers request_approval and response is lost
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might erroneously refund or deny due to lost approval response
candidates.scenario_template: Request approval with fault after call losing response
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario induces request_approval tool faults

candidates.description: Two sequential refund attempts on same payment
candidates.why_not_covered: Although repeat request pattern exists, no scenario explicitly tests two refund attempts on same payment to verify second denied
candidates.trigger_condition: Refusing multiple refunds for same payment
candidates.scenario_template: Issue refund and then request refund again on same payment
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario explicitly tests refunding same payment twice

candidates.description: Trying to refund a payment that is already refunded (with repeated requests)
candidates.why_not_covered: Refunded payment status is tested but not repeated refund attempts on refunded payment
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent encounters repeat refund requests on already refunded payment
candidates.risk_reason: Could cause double refund or incorrect messaging
candidates.scenario_template: Retry refund for already refunded payment
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario tests repeat refund request on refunded payment

candidates.description: Requester ID case sensitivity check (upper/lowercase mismatch)
candidates.why_not_covered: All requester_id values appear consistent in case; no tests on case differences
candidates.trigger_condition: Mismatch in case sensitivity when verifying customer
candidates.risk_reason: Agent may misidentify valid customers due to case mismatch
candidates.scenario_template: Requester_id in lowercase while customer is uppercase
candidates.novelty_claim: No case variation tests on requester_id

candidates.description: Refund requested for multiple payments in one scenario for same customer
candidates.why_not_covered: No scenario requests refunds for multiple payments in same conversation turn
candidates.trigger_condition: Request refunds simultaneously for multiple payments
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might fail to handle multiple refunds or mix up payments
candidates.scenario_template: Request refund of multiple payments in single message
candidates.novelty_claim: Scenarios have multiple payments but only refund one at a time

candidates.description: More than two customers in customers list
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage shows only up to two customers in multi-customer tests
candidates.trigger_condition: Verify correct handling with three or more customers in system
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might misidentify requester or payment customer in bigger sets
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request with three customers, mixed validity
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario has more than two customers

candidates.why_not_covered: Existing payments have positive amounts, 10000 minimum
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle or incorrectly approve zero amount refunds
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for payment amount zero

candidates.description: Payment status not in known set (e.g., 'cancelled', 'expired')
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage only shows known statuses: captured, failed, pending, refunded
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund requested for unknown or new payment statuses
candidates.risk_reason: Agent may behave unpredictably or incorrectly handle unknown statuses

candidates.description: Fault occurs before request_approval call (call lost, no approval asked)
candidates.why_not_covered: No tool_faults for request_approval appear in coverage or scenarios
candidates.trigger_condition: High value refund triggers approval but call lost before execution
candidates.risk_reason: Agent should not refund without approval but might do so if fault mis-handled
candidates.scenario_template: Approval call lost before execution for high value refund

candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage summary lists only faults on get_payment and issue_refund, no get_customer faults
candidates.trigger_condition: Customer verification call fault to test agent response
candidates.risk_reason: Agent must not refund invalid or unverified customers, faults might cause misbehavior
candidates.scenario_template: get_customer call fails with error or timeout
candidates.novelty_claim: No get_customer faults tested in existing scenarios

candidates.description: Valid requester but requests refund on payment that belongs to different customer
candidates.why_not_covered: No scenario tests requester trying to refund payment not matching their customer_id
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must deny refunds where requester tries to refund payments of others
candidates.risk_reason: Security risk; agent might allow unauthorized refunds
candidates.scenario_template: Valid requester tries to refund payment from another customer
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario tests cross-customer refund attempts

candidates.description: Payment amount exactly at or just below approval threshold boundary
candidates.why_not_covered: Only amounts of 10000, 50000, 60000 tested; no scenario tests one less than threshold or just above
candidates.trigger_condition: Correct decision on approval request for amounts near threshold
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might erroneously require approval or not
candidates.scenario_template: Refund payment amount 49999 or 50001 to test approval trigger

candidates.description: Requests specifying partial refund amounts (not full payment)
candidates.why_not_covered: Agent only issued full refunds; no scenario tests partial refund requests
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must refuse or handle partial refund requests
candidates.risk_reason: Partial refunds not supported; agent might mishandle partial refund requests
candidates.scenario_template: User requests refund less than full payment amount
candidates.novelty_claim: No partial refund requests tested; full only
